clips.title: The story
paras: At the Shrine of Aessina, Illiyana asks Alliance champions to strike at the satyrs of Ashenvale. Grieving her sister Anilia, she seeks vengeance and asks you to bring back satyr horns as proof.

Anilia's death has left Illiyana in grief at the Shrine of Aessina. Dryads are forest spirits bonded to nature, often playful and serene, and elusive to mortals. Anilia's brutal slaying shattered that calm for her sister. Illiyana now turns to Alliance travelers to strike down the demonic beasts responsible.

Satyrs were once night elves, but demonic energy corrupted them during the War of the Ancients. They lurk in defiled groves across Ashenvale and prey on the woods' inhabitants as servants of the Burning Legion. Bringing Illiyana their horns gives proof of vengeance and strikes at the fel presence encroaching on eastern Ashenvale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can't believe that Anilia is gone... We used to play together in the forests all the time. I almost feel... Sad.
I know something that might make me feel better. Please, slay the satyrs that took Anilia from me! Bring me their horns as proof of your actions and you will forever have my gratitude.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Please, help me avenge Anilia's death.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, kind traveler. My sister's spirit is gladdened by your efforts.
